verdict.what_is_wrong: From roughly 15:54:52 to 15:56:57 UTC, Java in one container suffered severe ready-but-not-running delays while using only about 0.2 CPU cores; the host had substantial idle CPU, so this was not host-wide CPU saturation. The evidence is consistent with a container-local CPU restriction, but the expected stable per-period CPU ceiling failed its check, and the trace has no quota/throttle counters, so I cannot confirm a CPU limit as the mechanism.
